sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS UnderagePatientsCount
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) < 18 AND strftime('%Y', E.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993
